CHAPTER 02 / 30

Brand story

قصة REX

REX is a creative space founded by partners whose ideas don't know limits.

REX is a creative space founded by a group of partners with one thing in common: their ideas don't know limits. We're not here to be a traditional marketing agency, or a production house that follows the usual rules. REX is where we can experiment, take risks, and turn the ideas others might call "crazy" into real campaigns. We don't build ideas to please everyone, and we don't let targets or templates set the ceiling. We believe in the vision first, and we work with brands and people who believe in it too and are ready to do something actually different. REX specialises in creative campaigns — bringing together every tool an idea needs, from strategy and marketing to production and execution.

REX isn't a place where we work inside the limits. REX is where we find out what happens when we remove them.

REX هي مساحة إبداعية أسسها مجموعة من الـpartners يجمعهم شيء واحد: أفكارهم ما تعرف الحدود.

مو هدفنا نكون Marketing Agency تقليدية، ولا Production House تمشي على نفس القواعد المعتادة. REX هي المساحة اللي نكدر بيها نجرب، نغامر، ونحوّل الأفكار اللي ممكن غيرنا يعتبرها “مجنونة” إلى حملات حقيقية.

هنا ما نبني أفكارنا حتى ترضي الجميع، وما نخلي الـtargets أو القوالب التقليدية تحدد سقف الإبداع. نؤمن بالـvision أولاً، ونشتغل ويا البراندات والأشخاص اللي يؤمنون بيها ويكونون مستعدين يسوون شي مختلف فعلاً.

REX متخصصة بالـCreative Campaigns، ومن خلالها نجمع كل الأدوات اللي تحتاجها الفكرة، من الاستراتيجية والتسويق إلى الإنتاج والتنفيذ، حتى تطلع الحملة بالشكل اللي تخيلناه من البداية.

REX مو مكان نشتغل بيه داخل الحدود. REX هي المكان اللي نكتشف بيه شنو يصير من نشيلها.

Source of truth: the approved REX story. No history, clients, figures or achievements have been added.

CHAPTER 06 / 30

Tagline & philosophy

السلوگن والفلسفة

Rules End.

We don't start with “what's usually done?” — we start with “what can we do?”.

ما نبدأ بـ«شنو المتعارف عليه؟»، نبدأ بـ«شنو نكدر نسوي؟».

Xperiments Begin.

Where the limits end, the experiment starts: new ideas, unexpected execution, calculated risk.

ومن تنتهي الحدود، تبدأ التجربة: أفكار جديدة، طرق تنفيذ غير متوقعة، ومخاطرة محسوبة.

The X is intentional. “Xperiments” is always written with an X. Never correct it to “Experiments”. Spell-check dictionaries must include it.

CHAPTER 07 / 30

Creative concept

الفكرة الإبداعية

The moment before an idea becomes real.

We show the trace of thinking — paper, marks, attempts, arrows, notes, cuts, movement — and then that energy resolves into a clear system and a finished result.

Four design principles

Mark first, grid second.

Every layout starts from a human mark and lands on a precise grid. The hand gives the energy; the system makes it work.

One break per frame.

Only one element breaks the grid — usually the X. If everything breaks, nothing does.

Say it with the idea.

Short lines, strong verbs, no superlatives. Boldness is shown, never claimed.

Ink first.

Every mark, logo and layout must work in black on paper before colour is added.

Child × professional

The child makes the mark; the team makes it work. Spontaneity lives in the lettering, the REX Marks and the character. Professionalism lives in the grid, the typography, the spacing, the colour ratios and the production detail. The three tiers (Quiet / Active / Wild) set how much hand vs. system each piece gets: Quiet 90/10, Active 70/30, Wild 50/50 — system always keeps the majority.

Its one weakness — detail at 16 px — is fixed with an optically heavier compact cut, not by replacing the idea. The X mark becomes the short form (favicon, avatar, watermark); the Dino mark and the Stamp are supporting marks for culture, crew and merch.

CHAPTER 09 / 30

Primary logo — deep dive

اللوكو الأساسي

R — the confident start

Stem pressed hard at the top, bowl in one continuous stroke, leg kicks just past the baseline. Tilted −1.2°.

E — uneven on purpose

Three arms, three lengths: top 44, middle 32, bottom 48 units. Spine and arms are separate strokes that overlap like real marker. Tilted +1.6°.

X — the last stroke

The free stroke overshoots the baseline and flicks. The breaking stroke starts above the cap line — outside the rules — and lands inside. This is “Rules End.” drawn.

Built as custom lettering on REX's own marker engine: every stroke is a centreline with a pressure profile (15–21 % of cap height) and a chisel nib at 32°, then outlined into clean vector. No typeface was used.

Why Space Grotesk: its quirky details (the flat-sided G, the open R leg) echo hand lettering without imitating it, and it has no gaming/tech clichés. Tested against a neutral grotesk; kept for character. Alexandria matches its geometric width and x-height, so Arabic lines sit with equal weight.

CHAPTER 16 / 30

Arabic / English typesetting

التنضيد العربي والإنجليزي

  • Arabic is never a smaller translation: equal hierarchy, Arabic set ~8–10 % smaller in px to match optical size.
  • Arabic line-height is 1.2–1.3× the Latin value (1.85 for body). No letter-spacing on Arabic, ever.
  • Bilingual layouts: Latin aligns left, Arabic aligns right, sharing the same baseline grid. On single-language pieces, align to the reading start.
  • English words inside Arabic (Creative Campaigns, vision, targets) stay in Latin script — that's how REX talks.
  • Numbers: Western digits (0–9) by default in both scripts, tabular for data. Eastern Arabic digits (٠–٩) only for fully formal Arabic documents — open question for the partners.
  • Iraqi letters گ and چ are supported by Alexandria — keep them; don't “formalise” the dialect.

Bring the brief.

جيب البريف.

Same line, same weight, two scripts.

CHAPTER 17 / 30

Character system

شخصية REX

REX is an original T-Rex: curious, calm and quick — a maker, not a bully. He is never inside every logo; he brings personality to campaigns, social and culture.

Differences from the reference images, by design: no sunglasses, no crown, no real-brand sneakers, different palette (Acid skin, Orange hoodie), flat bold-line style instead of pencil hatching, pencil tucked behind the brow as the signature accessory.

CHAPTER 18 / 30

Doodles & pencil system

الشخابيط والأقلام

  • Maximum three marks per layout; one per element they respond to.
  • Marks sit on top of the grid, never replace it. Line weight 3–6 % of the heading's cap height.
  • Ink or the one accent in use — never multi-coloured doodles.
CHAPTER 19 / 30

The X device

أداة الـX

The X is not decoration. It is an action: it breaks the frame, switches colour, reveals an image, cuts text, and moves a design from system to experiment.

Anatomy: one precise, geometric line (the Rules) crossed by one free marker stroke (the Xperiment) that always overshoots the frame. Only one X per composition.

CHAPTER 20 / 30

Patterns & textures

الأنماط والخامات

Texture is a human layer, not a filter: max one texture per layout, ≤ 15 % visible, never over faces or small text.

CHAPTER 21 / 30

Layout system

نظام التصميم

12-column grid, margins = 1/14 of the short side, gutter = 1/45 of the long side. Big, bold headings; generous empty space; one element — usually the X — may break the grid per composition. Labels and credits stay aligned to the grid, always.

CHAPTER 22 / 30

Photography

التصوير

Shoot

  • Real work moments: teams arguing over a board, drawing, reviewing a take.
  • Hands, paper, lenses, cameras, monitors, gaffer tape.
  • Real locations and sets; low or very close angles.
  • Direct flash or hard light when it serves the idea; calculated motion blur.
  • Imperfect frames, chosen consciously. Grade keeps Ink blacks and warm paper whites; Acid appears only if it's really in the scene.

Never

  • Stock meeting photos, handshakes, forced corporate smiles.
  • Neon cyberpunk that has nothing to do with the idea.
  • Random images used to fill space.
  • Logos on busy photos without an Ink or Paper field.

No REX photography exists yet, so every template uses a clearly marked hatched placeholder. A first brand shoot is listed in the open questions.

CHAPTER 24 / 30

Motion & sound

الحركة والصوت

Behaviour: lines drawn fast along their real path · a pencil enters and leaves a real trace · the X changes the system · marks respond after the hit · a short pause lets the name read. Sound: pencil scratch, marker drag, paper flick, a sharp hit on the X with a light bass accent. No dinosaur roar.

CHAPTER 25 / 30

Tone of voice

نبرة الصوت

  • Direct, smart, confident, close. Short lines in campaigns. Verbs over adjectives.
  • Boldness shows in the idea — never by repeating “bold”.
  • Arabic is white Iraqi when speaking locally, readable to any Arab. English words mix in naturally and sparingly.
  • No claims like “we make the impossible”, “we change the world”, “the best, unrivalled”. Never “Not just an agency”.

Manifesto

We don't start with "what's usually done?"
We start with "what can we do?"

REX is where the rules end — not because rules are bad, but because they were never the point.
The point is the idea. The one someone called too crazy. The one that didn't fit the template, or the target.

We give that idea room. We test it, break it, draw it again, and push it until it holds.
We're not afraid of the first draft. Or the tenth.
Then we bring every tool it needs — strategy, marketing, production, execution — so it comes out exactly the way we saw it at the start.

We don't build ideas to please everyone.
We build them with brands and people who believe in the vision, and are ready to do something actually different.

Rules end. Xperiments begin.

REX isn't a place where we work inside the limits.
It's where we find out what happens when we remove them.
ما نبدأ بـ«شنو المتعارف عليه؟»
نبدأ بـ«شنو نكدر نسوي؟»

REX هي المكان اللي تنتهي بيه القواعد — مو لأن القواعد غلط، بس لأنها ما چانت هي الهدف.
الهدف هو الفكرة. الفكرة اللي أحد گال عليها «مجنونة». اللي ما دخلت بالقالب، ولا بالـtarget.

إحنا ننطيها مساحة. نجربها، نكسرها، نرسمها من جديد، ونشتغل عليها لحد ما توگف على رجلها.
ما نخاف من المسودة الأولى، ولا من الثانية، ولا من العاشرة.
بعدين نجمع كل الأدوات اللي تحتاجها — استراتيجية، تسويق، إنتاج، تنفيذ — حتى تطلع مثل ما شفناها أول مرة.

ما نبني أفكارنا حتى ترضي الكل.
نبنيها ويا البراندات والناس اللي يؤمنون بالـvision، ومستعدين يسوون شي مختلف فعلاً.

Brand architecture

هيكلية البراند

Model: endorsed / master-brand. REX is always the larger, first element; a unit is a descriptor in Space Grotesk Medium, uppercase, +120 tracking, set after a precise rule at 34 % of cap height. REX stays Ink (or Paper); only the descriptor may take one accent — one accent per unit.

Naming Examples — Not Final. REX Creative, REX Production, REX Strategy and REX Labs are structural examples only, not official names.
